answer: CuriousLLM 增强 KGP 的方向在摘要结论中被表述为：KGP 原本是“an LLM-based traversal agent”的方法，而 CuriousLLM 是“an enhancement that integrates a curiosity-driven reasoning mechanism into an LLM agent”[chunk_43145c0748762d6b4c650c65721f826f]。其职责之一是开发 Follow-upQA 数据集，该数据集“includes questions and supporting evidence as input, with follow-up questions serving as ground truths”[chunk_43145c0748762d6b4c650c65721f826f]。关于“反过来 KGP 使用 CuriousLLM 的 Follow-upQA 训练”，原文只支持 CuriousLLM 自身在 Follow-upQA 上微调：“after fine-tuning on the Follow-upQA dataset”描述的是“our LLM agent”[chunk_f783bd933d0d2a437496939e022a776a]；没有证据表明 KGP 反向使用该数据集训练。KGP 一侧的职责是构建知识图并让基于 LLM 的 KG 遍历代理交替生成证据与选择邻居[chunk_4c2f9284ed69432f1dd6ad5217a9a783]；CuriousLLM 一侧则是让代理生成后续问题以引导检索[chunk_43145c0748762d6b4c650c65721f826f]。结论段将两者合称为“CuriousLLM-enhanced KGP framework”，并再次把 Follow-upQA 数据集与 curiosity-driven LLM traversal agent 列为引入项[chunk_5fc8dbfce1b251b220ab2cf787ef236b]。

Our new CuriousLLM-enhanced KGP framework
represents a significant advance in the field of MD-
QA by integrating an LLM-guided prompt refor-

effectively addresses challenges like hallucination,
